def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}

    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

lib='''def components(grid, color):
    """The 4-connected components of cells of the given color, as lists of (row, col)."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in grid]
    out = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == color and not seen[i][j]:
                comp = []; st = [(i, j)]; seen[i][j] = True
                while st:
                    a, b = st.pop(); comp.append((a, b))
                    for x, y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == color and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y] = True; st.append((x, y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def bbox(cells):
    """The bounding box (top, left, bottom, right) of a list of (row, col) cells."""
    rs = [p[0] for p in cells]; cs = [p[1] for p in cells]
    return min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs)

def paint(grid, cells, color):
    """The grid with the given (row, col) cells recolored (mutates and returns the grid)."""
    for x, y in cells:
        grid[x][y] = color
    return grid
